==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
* [[Charr Invaders]] (from [[Artificer Mullenix]] in [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]])

== Note ==

* Winds works similarly to any [[Nature Ritual]]: its energy cost is reduced by [[Expertise]] and it is affected by skills that trigger on any ritual (but not those that affect only [[Binding Ritual]]s).

{{ Bug| Winds does not appear on the effects monitor.}}

==Trivia==
* Creates the [[Spirit of High Winds]], which has the appearance of a spirit created by a nature ritual.
* During Prophecies beta there was a nature ritual called [[High Winds]] which had a similar effect. It was removed prior to release.
